sources.title: Time-adaptive Unsupervised Auditory Attention Decoding Using EEG-based Stimulus Reconstruction
sources.authors: Simon Geirnaert; Tom Francart; Alexander Bertrand
sources.actual_read: Author-hosted 12-page PDF parsed: abstract/introduction and SectionII.A through covariance/shrinkage equations4–7; further recursive-section find timed out. No full implementation audit.
sources.supported: Adaptive auditory stimulus reconstruction with sliding-window/recursive updates predates this project. It consumes streaming EEG and competing speech envelopes; absence of attention labels is not absence of speech input. Generic time adaptation to EEG nonstationarity is prior art.
sources.implication: A proposed EEG-only slow-state model must specify no inference audio/target access and identify a task-relevant contribution beyond adaptive covariance or relabeled time adaptation.

sources.title: Fast, accurate, unsupervised, and time-adaptive EEG-based auditory attention decoding for neuro-steered hearing devices
sources.authors: Simon Geirnaert; Rob Zink; Tom Francart; Alexander Bertrand
sources.actual_read: Author-hosted chapter, parsed abstract and Sections1–2.1 plus opening2.2 only; not used as independent performance evidence.
sources.supported: Authors distinguish user-specific adaptation from fixed user-independent models and summarize EEG-plus-speech unsupervised stimulus reconstruction. Not evidence for our EEG-only envelope protocol.
